name: panel-bridge
description: Client-side browser extension that translates speech bubbles on webcomic pages you can already open — M1: detect and outline every bubble on a live Naver Webtoon chapter.

scripts.postinstall: playwright-core install chromium || echo 'panel-bridge: Chromium download skipped — run `npx playwright-core install chromium` before `npm run demo:m1`, or set M1_CDP to a running Chrome'

author: krantikaridev contributors
